title: Knee Cut Position
description: The top player cuts the knee across the thigh line while working to win the underhook or crossface and control the hip line.
topPlayerGoals: The top player wants to control Knee Cut Position through head position, inside position, and directed pressure.
Separate the shoulder line from the hip line, then windshield-wiper the foot free.
Keep a stable base so you are not off-balanced or countered.
bottomPlayerGoals: The bottom player wants to survive Knee Cut Position with frames, pummeling, or the right angle.
Pummel for a knee shield or underhook to wrestle up or recover guard.
Recognize danger signals early instead of waiting for the position to settle.
controlPoints: Main control point: Near-knee angle, far underhook, or crossface..
Head, hands, hips, and knees should share the same force direction.
The elbow-knee connection or hip-shoulder line determines whether the position is still alive or already locked.
escapePriorities: Escape priority: Do not let the shoulder line get flattened before recovering the knee..
Protect the neck, back, knee line, or arm line before countering.
If inside position is lost, reset one defensive layer first.

advancementOptions.action: Clear the foot and settle the pin
advancementOptions.why: This is the natural branch when you win the main control point and the opponent is forced to defend.

dangerSignals: The chin or neck is pulled out of a safe line.
The elbow separates from the ribs or knee.
The hip line is locked while the shoulder line is still being pulled.
You need a long hand post to avoid falling.
